note: MetaMask test from the production app (aidpledge-bars26.vercel.app) on Bradbury testnet, contract 0xa32C73fd75FC2e5b52484fCE2B8758D046CbA62F, five validators per transaction. The tester backs a demo pledge of $200M from the UK to the Sudan 2025 plan by 2026-03-31, with the UK's IATI publisher GB-GOV-1 as the second source and their own wallet as the beneficiary, then reports the shortfall, concedes it and withdraws. The app deposits what each write needs before sending it; the writes themselves send no GEN. Every step was decided 5/5.
steps: Deposit 1 GEN (sent by the app before backing the pledge)
Back a pledge: UK to Sudan HNRP 2025, $200M by 2026-03-31, IATI GB-GOV-1, payout 1 GEN, bond 1 GEN from the deposit
pledge_2 active, 5/5: validators read the GOV.UK release as MATCH for donor 2917 and plan 1220 and agreed GB-GOV-1 (FCDO) is the UK; plan country SD
Deposit the 0.1 GEN stake (sent by the app before reporting)
claim_2 BREACHED, 5/5: FTS $141,078,936 in 22 flows (all read, matching FTS's count); the UK's own IATI reports $160,709,747 in 14 activities; the larger is $39,290,253 short of $200M (19.64%)
Concede and pay now (settle claim_2 as the pledger)
paid, 5/5: 0.1965 GEN of the bond (19.64%) credited, 0.1768 GEN to the beneficiary and 0.0196 GEN to the reporter, plus the 0.1 GEN stake back; 0.8035 GEN stays bonded
